plain: Government run by religious leaders in the name of God

webster.text: Government of a state by the immediate direction of God; or the state thus governed.

example.quote: Sir, the instance adduced from the history of the Jewish theocracy evinces that there are certain situations in communities which will unavoidably lead to results similar to those we experience.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, New York Convention, June 20, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
